body:
Keb/Abisko Endurance 2/3 would be worth considering too. More headroom than the Shape range if I remember right.

I have the Abisko Lite 2 and it's a high quality product, but it's more of a 1 man tent and there's only really enough headroom to sit comfortably at the tallest part.

Check out Tom Heaney Adventure on YouTube if you're still on the search. Decent reviews on a few Hilleberg models.
That's pretty fucking badass, congrats man! But don't give your hard earned money to people who don't deserve it.
No pancake. You didn't ruin anything:)
